::: {#perfil}

MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp, research assistant at the GAIA Lab, and researcher 
at CBPF (Brazilian Center for Physics Research). She holds double BSc degrees in Applied Mathematics and in Data 
Science and AI from the same school. At the GAIA Lab she applies deep learning and computer vision to satellite imagery; 
at CBPF she applies deep learning and computer vision to image, video, and 3D sensing in the Oil & Gas and Sports domains.

## Education

- MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Data Science and AI, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Applied Mathematics, FGV EMAp.

## Interests

Deep learning, computer vision, and uncertainty quantification.
